pageProps.title: Zootopia 2 (2025)
pageProps.review: Zootopia 2 is an animated film where you can feel the deep charm of a fable for adults and the craftsmanship of the production team through elaborate animal engineering design and hidden homages throughout.
pageProps.content:
## Review I definitely felt that Zootopia is a fable for adults.
I could glimpse the deep consideration and craftsmanship of the production team in the homages and hints hidden throughout the work, and the elaborate animal engineering design.
